units.rawText: Before the performance, theater backstage.
units.displayText: Before the performance, theater backstage.

spans.text: Before the performance, theater backstage.

units.rawText: As Undine and her aides make their final preparations, a man suddenly interjects.
units.displayText: As Undine and her aides make their final preparations, a man suddenly interjects.

spans.text: As Undine and her aides make their final preparations, a man suddenly interjects.

units.rawText: Oi, Un-something-or-other! Change of plans. The guests say they want to see how good you really are with a more extravagant piece.
units.displayText: Oi, Un-something-or-other! Change of plans. The guests say they want to see how good you really are with a more extravagant piece.

spans.text: Oi, Un-something-or-other! Change of plans. The guests say they want to see how good you really are with a more extravagant piece.

units.rawText: Here, the piece's sent to your terminal.
units.displayText: Here, the piece's sent to your terminal.

spans.text: Here, the piece's sent to your terminal.

units.rawText: Th... This piece isn't a conventional composition and isn't the type of piece a ceremonial orchestra would perform.
units.displayText: Th... This piece isn't a conventional composition and isn't the type of piece a ceremonial orchestra would perform.

spans.text: Th... This piece isn't a conventional composition and isn't the type of piece a ceremonial orchestra would perform.

units.rawText: These counter-melodies and gestures are very difficult too, and in such a short time...
units.displayText: These counter-melodies and gestures are very difficult too, and in such a short time...

spans.text: These counter-melodies and gestures are very difficult too, and in such a short time...

units.rawText: What, can't you do it?
units.displayText: What, can't you do it?

spans.text: What, can't you do it?

units.rawText: We can, but for the sake of the orchestra's performance...
units.displayText: We can, but for the sake of the orchestra's performance...

spans.text: We can, but for the sake of the orchestra's performance...

units.rawText: However you handle it is your own business. If it all comes crashing down, don't blame me for not telling you.
units.displayText: However you handle it is your own business. If it all comes crashing down, don't blame me for not telling you.

spans.text: However you handle it is your own business. If it all comes crashing down, don't blame me for not telling you.

units.rawText: The assistant in front of her is far more direct than the secretary. Undine now understands that point very well.
units.displayText: The assistant in front of her is far more direct than the secretary. Undine now understands that point very well.

spans.text: The assistant in front of her is far more direct than the secretary. Undine now understands that point very well.

units.rawText: After a brief period of painful silence, Undine lowers her head, answering bitterly.
units.displayText: After a brief period of painful silence, Undine lowers her head, answering bitterly.

spans.text: After a brief period of painful silence, Undine lowers her head, answering bitterly.

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: Now then, guests from far and wide, the next performance shall be delivered by the mysterious Doll prepared for our fine guests!
units.displayText: Now then, guests from far and wide, the next performance shall be delivered by the mysterious Doll prepared for our fine guests!

spans.text: Now then, guests from far and wide, the next performance shall be delivered by the mysterious Doll prepared for our fine guests!

units.rawText: They're a top-tier product acquired at the cost of a fortune by our gracious host! As for what this big name is capable of, I'm sure everyone present will see with their own eyes!
units.displayText: They're a top-tier product acquired at the cost of a fortune by our gracious host! As for what this big name is capable of, I'm sure everyone present will see with their own eyes!

spans.text: They're a top-tier product acquired at the cost of a fortune by our gracious host! As for what this big name is capable of, I'm sure everyone present will see with their own eyes!

units.rawText: Waves of babbling comes from the crowd. Undine can discern the senator and her master as well their subordinates' hushed muttering in the crowd.
units.displayText: Waves of babbling comes from the crowd. Undine can discern the senator and her master as well their subordinates' hushed muttering in the crowd.

spans.text: Waves of babbling comes from the crowd. Undine can discern the senator and her master as well their subordinates' hushed muttering in the crowd.

units.rawText: They all doubt Undine's capabilities, and some even emit malicious laughter. Undine knows perfectly well that only success in this performance can display her abilities in full.
units.displayText: They all doubt Undine's capabilities, and some even emit malicious laughter. Undine knows perfectly well that only success in this performance can display her abilities in full.

spans.text: They all doubt Undine's capabilities, and some even emit malicious laughter. Undine knows perfectly well that only success in this performance can display her abilities in full.

units.rawText: She makes her final adjustments, and steps onto that familiar yet strange stage once more. Allowing the melody to manifest in her neural cloud, she lets it flow with the conductor's rhythm.
units.displayText: She makes her final adjustments, and steps onto that familiar yet strange stage once more. Allowing the melody to manifest in her neural cloud, she lets it flow with the conductor's rhythm.

spans.text: She makes her final adjustments, and steps onto that familiar yet strange stage once more. Allowing the melody to manifest in her neural cloud, she lets it flow with the conductor's rhythm.

units.rawText: Even if it is a brand-new performance piece that's been forcibly added, they are still going to perform it to the highest standards, with the greatest intensity—
units.displayText: Even if it is a brand-new performance piece that's been forcibly added, they are still going to perform it to the highest standards, with the greatest intensity—

spans.text: Even if it is a brand-new performance piece that's been forcibly added, they are still going to perform it to the highest standards, with the greatest intensity—

units.rawText: (Nearly at the end of the first movement! Next... Ugh!)
units.displayText: Nearly at the end of the first movement! Next... Ugh!

spans.text: Nearly at the end of the first movement! Next... Ugh!

units.rawText: (It hurts... Nearly affected the movements. No, there's no way I'll let this performance fail!)
units.displayText: It hurts... Nearly affected the movements. No, there's no way I'll let this performance fail!

spans.text: It hurts... Nearly affected the movements. No, there's no way I'll let this performance fail!

units.rawText: Undine swivels around, disguising the issues brought from the pain by producing an imperceptible shake that goes unnoticed by the crowd.
units.displayText: Undine swivels around, disguising the issues brought from the pain by producing an imperceptible shake that goes unnoticed by the crowd.

spans.text: Undine swivels around, disguising the issues brought from the pain by producing an imperceptible shake that goes unnoticed by the crowd.

units.rawText: (Damn, there's several malfunction possibilities, and spread out over my body, too. All injuries that I didn't have time to get fixed before...)
units.displayText: Damn, there's several malfunction possibilities, and spread out over my body, too. All injuries that I didn't have time to get fixed before...

spans.text: Damn, there's several malfunction possibilities, and spread out over my body, too. All injuries that I didn't have time to get fixed before...

units.rawText: (I managed to hide that with the turn just then, but the vast majority of this piece is still left. If we continue at this level, I can only hold on for a bit longer.)
units.displayText: I managed to hide that with the turn just then, but the vast majority of this piece is still left. If we continue at this level, I can only hold on for a bit longer.

spans.text: I managed to hide that with the turn just then, but the vast majority of this piece is still left. If we continue at this level, I can only hold on for a bit longer.

units.rawText: (No, not at a time like—)
units.displayText: No, not at a time like—

spans.text: No, not at a time like—

units.rawText:
<size=28>Beep—
(It's, alright...)</size>
units.displayText:
Beep—
(It's, alright...)

spans.text:
Beep—
(It's, alright...)

units.rawText:
<size=28>Beep—
(We are, here.)</size>
units.displayText:
Beep—
(We are, here.)

spans.text:
Beep—
(We are, here.)

units.rawText: From the outside, these instruments and their conductor appear to continue in their rhythm unperturbed, but those on the stage know within their hearts—like the connection between them—it was all crumbling down.
units.displayText: From the outside, these instruments and their conductor appear to continue in their rhythm unperturbed, but those on the stage know within their hearts—like the connection between them—it was all crumbling down.

spans.text: From the outside, these instruments and their conductor appear to continue in their rhythm unperturbed, but those on the stage know within their hearts—like the connection between them—it was all crumbling down.

units.rawText: (No! If you substitute and support me like this, all of you will collapse! All of your joints are already in tatters...)
units.displayText: No! If you substitute and support me like this, all of you will collapse! All of your joints are already in tatters...

spans.text: No! If you substitute and support me like this, all of you will collapse! All of your joints are already in tatters...

units.rawText:
<size=28>Beep—
(Don't, worry.)</size>
units.displayText:
Beep—
(Don't, worry.)

spans.text:
Beep—
(Don't, worry.)

units.rawText:
<size=28>Beep—
(Performance, continue.)</size>
units.displayText:
Beep—
(Performance, continue.)

spans.text:
Beep—
(Performance, continue.)

units.rawText: The Dolls forge onwards using the mechanical familiarity they've gained from countless performances, not stopping for even a second, and persisting through this hellish performance.
units.displayText: The Dolls forge onwards using the mechanical familiarity they've gained from countless performances, not stopping for even a second, and persisting through this hellish performance.

spans.text: The Dolls forge onwards using the mechanical familiarity they've gained from countless performances, not stopping for even a second, and persisting through this hellish performance.

units.rawText: Each and every note, each and every step brings the Dolls closer to the edge of toppling, and all the while melodies harmonize, the performance flawless.
units.displayText: Each and every note, each and every step brings the Dolls closer to the edge of toppling, and all the while melodies harmonize, the performance flawless.

spans.text: Each and every note, each and every step brings the Dolls closer to the edge of toppling, and all the while melodies harmonize, the performance flawless.

units.rawText: Relaxing slightly as the piece slows, Undine regained her footing and braces for the coda of the piece.
units.displayText: Relaxing slightly as the piece slows, Undine regained her footing and braces for the coda of the piece.

spans.text: Relaxing slightly as the piece slows, Undine regained her footing and braces for the coda of the piece.

units.rawText: (These guys, with such severe impairments... Performing at this intensity will only make the accumulated injuries worse.)
units.displayText: These guys, with such severe impairments... Performing at this intensity will only make the accumulated injuries worse.

spans.text: These guys, with such severe impairments... Performing at this intensity will only make the accumulated injuries worse.

units.rawText: (Of the few deep inspections we had before, they all let me have the best of it... Were they hiding their circumstances on purpose?)
units.displayText: Of the few deep inspections we had before, they all let me have the best of it... Were they hiding their circumstances on purpose?

spans.text: Of the few deep inspections we had before, they all let me have the best of it... Were they hiding their circumstances on purpose?

units.rawText: (As the conductor of the orchestra, I should be the one taking up the mantle to protect my subordinates, but I...)
units.displayText: As the conductor of the orchestra, I should be the one taking up the mantle to protect my subordinates, but I...

spans.text: As the conductor of the orchestra, I should be the one taking up the mantle to protect my subordinates, but I...

units.rawText: (...To prove our value, to prove that we are worthy of being repaired, all we can do is—)
units.displayText: ...To prove our value, to prove that we are worthy of being repaired, all we can do is—

spans.text: ...To prove our value, to prove that we are worthy of being repaired, all we can do is—

units.rawText: A spiraling climax flourishes within the hall, surging upwards towards the heavens.
units.displayText: A spiraling climax flourishes within the hall, surging upwards towards the heavens.

spans.text: A spiraling climax flourishes within the hall, surging upwards towards the heavens.

units.rawText: With thunderous applause, the curtain falls pristinely once more—
units.displayText: With thunderous applause, the curtain falls pristinely once more—

spans.text: With thunderous applause, the curtain falls pristinely once more—

units.rawText: It's finally over. I wonder how they're doing.
units.displayText: It's finally over. I wonder how they're doing.

spans.text: It's finally over. I wonder how they're doing.

units.rawText: <size=28>Those neurally incomplete idiots better not have snapped like overstressed strings.</size>
units.displayText: Those neurally incomplete idiots better not have snapped like overstressed strings.

spans.text: Those neurally incomplete idiots better not have snapped like overstressed strings.

units.rawText: I... still have questions I want to ask them.
units.displayText: I... still have questions I want to ask them.

spans.text: I... still have questions I want to ask them.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: Where'd they go?
units.displayText: Where'd they go?

spans.text: Where'd they go?
